audio.voText: Oh no, the little bird's nest is broken. Bunny wants to rebuild it. What can help?
Look around. Which things could help build the nest?
Can the broken twig still help? Drag it to the nest.
What about the short grass? Drag it to the nest.
Can the torn leaf help too? Drag it to the nest.
And the bent feather? Drag it to the nest.
And the feather can make it soft. You did it! All those little things helped rebuild the nest.
Ganesha's tusk reminds us: even broken things can still help.
